Package dev.salusa.crypto

Class XAes256Gcm

java.lang.Object
dev.salusa.crypto.XAes256Gcm
public final class XAes256Gcm extends Object
An implementation of XAES-256-GCM (v1.0.1).

The API for this class is based heavily on Java's Cipher API.

Since:
1.1.0
See Also:

    • init

      public void init(int cipherMode, XAes256GcmKeySpec key) throws InvalidKeyException
      Initializes this object for encryption or wrapping with a random IV. You can then retrieve the random IV by calling getIV(). If you do not retrieve and save the IV, you will not be able to decrypt the data later on.
      Parameters:
      cipherMode - either Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE or Cipher.WRAP_MODE
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if cipherMode is not Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE or Cipher.WRAP_MODE
      InvalidKeyException
